quote: My wife and I became interested in the Italian Campaign after meeting American World War 2 veterans on Honor Flights to Washington DC. We were fortunate to find Frank de Planta and to join one of his tours. His description of the battles, the tactics, the objectives and the local area were surpassed only by his passion for this historical event. Everything about the tour was a memorable experience and we highly recommend it. Take this tour: you will not be disappointed.
name: Charlie and Linda Gray
